problem: The formula check permits deviations within a relative tolerance of 1e-6 or an absolute tolerance of 1e-9 kN, but the authoritative requirement specifies FI = Cf * FIB without any tolerance. This can accept nonconforming FI values.
required_change: Remove the undeclared tolerance and report a violation whenever the unit-adjusted decimal FI value is not exactly equal to Cf multiplied by FIB.
regression_guard: Preserve exact enforcement of the stated formula unless an authoritative tolerance is explicitly supplied.

problem: Every calculation case linked through the generic hasCalculationCase property is required to have positiveShearForce. The requirement governs positive-shear cases but does not prohibit the same ship from having calculation cases for other shear-force directions, so legitimate non-positive cases would be rejected.
required_change: Apply the positive-shear constraints only to qualifying positive-shear calculation cases, for example with a qualified value shape, while allowing other linked calculation cases to exist.
regression_guard: Preserve applicability to positive-shear cases without constraining unrelated calculation-case directions.
